verdict.rationale: The speech-to-text API documents exporting each transcript to a list of additional formats (docs-18), and the product is pitched as producing captions, subtitles and editable transcripts (docs-11). That is the product's own per-transcript export, but nothing shows account-wide export of all user data, and the specific open formats are not named. Missing for 10: bulk or account-level data export, named open export formats, an account exit or deletion workflow, independent corroboration.
